blind_postseal_rule.archive_completeness: Retain every archive member and every page of the registered supplementary PDF; do not select only favorable product pages.
blind_postseal_rule.product_vector: Retain every reported elimination product identity, starting-material identity, product amount or yield inscription, regioisomer or stereoisomer inscription, unsuccessful or recovered-material record, alternative product, optimization row and mechanism control in source order.
blind_postseal_rule.structural_test: For every complete reported elimination transform whose full reactant and product structures are present, reconstruct the exact atom and held-support carrier and test the sealed inverse-addition law without importing a named mechanism, yield threshold or favored-product selector.
blind_postseal_rule.absence: Any structure that cannot be reconstructed exactly remains unresolved; any mismatch remains adverse; neither class may be omitted.
blind_postseal_rule.observation_order: The law, target identities and predicted product-vector relation seal before the supplementary archive opens.

native_arithmetic_boundary: No external numerical zero, signed, decimal, continuum, yield, temperature, time, energy or conventional structure inscription enters native forcing; structural absence is EmptyOne.
